name: 一週間の気分の並び
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0007「一週間の気分の並び」, one compact Japanese weekly mood strip.
Reference hierarchy: Image 1 ORIGINAL Calm screenshot controls artwork, mood assignments, icon geometry/proportions, stroke/optical weight, spacing and fine details. Use ONLY its YOUR WEEK card. Image 2 FigCraft mock is SECONDARY for Japanese labels/layout; its face substitutions are inaccurate: Tuesday neutral smile instead of relaxed, Friday excited instead of stressed, Sunday unsure instead of happy. Its mint circles and dark crop squares are not authoritative. Image 3 approved Lighthouse bus is STYLE ONLY for white rounded surface, fine neutral outline, restrained downward shadow.
Render one white rounded card on pure white canvas, logical390x162 proportion, compact single row of seven mood-day columns. Header centered「今週の気分」in Meiryo Regular14/24. Weekdays exactly「月」「火」「水」「木」「金」「土」「日」above circles; dates exactly「1」「2」「3」「4」「5」「6」「7」below, Meiryo Regular12/16, tracking0, ink#1D1D1D, quiet gray weekdays.
Exact visible state from ORIGINAL:
Monday1 empty neutral outline circle.
Tuesday2 relaxed closed-eyes peaceful-smile ORIGINAL yellow emoji on small blue/lavender mood badge, retain subtle neutral outer halo.
Wednesday3 anxious clenched-teeth ORIGINAL yellow emoji on small muted purple/pink badge, subtle neutral halo.
Thursday4 empty neutral outline circle.
Friday5 stressed squeezed-eyes crease-brow small-open-mouth ORIGINAL yellow emoji on small coral badge.
Saturday6 empty neutral outline circle.
Sunday7 happy closed-smiling-eyes broad-smile ORIGINAL yellow emoji on small cyan-blue badge.
Preserve the original artwork expressions and exact day assignments; no replacement with generic emoji. Remove dark square background artifacts around cropped art. No new record, checkmark or selected day. All7 columns equally spaced and aligned.
Accent decision: small blue/purple/coral/cyan badges carry the recorded mood categories; retain the ORIGINAL mapping. Purple here is actual mood artwork/group meaning, not a randomly colored form icon. Empty circles stay white with fine neutral outlines, no mint-fill strip or broad colored panel. No green CTA, extra text, navigation, chart, metric, legend, divider or outside page content. Full card visible with modest white margin; no clipping, glossy plastic, glow, device frame or watermark. Static raster candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画・日本語モック・4クロップを実見し、原画を図像/細部の主参照とした。火=落ち着く、水=不安、金=張りつめる、日=うれしいという原画の対応を回復、空の月木土は中立色。青/紫/コーラル/シアンは実際の気分カテゴリの小バッジに限定。結果実見:曜日/1-7/表情対応/白面は維持。ただし火水の薄い外輪が省略されたため限定修正が必要。厳密な原画図像/書体は未証明。所有者承認/編集性/実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
